size_reason: Turn-end refuse-hook on a harness command-name node that stayed open across the next captain message with no matching artifact. Captain locked block-one-message-late. Full adversary rounds are a later ship if the light refuse is trusted.
shape: An owner-invoke node stayed open across the captain's next message without a matching artifact.
structure: bin/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.sh R-owner-node-open on turn.owner_nodes gathered from a non-meta user <command-name> record plus a later is_captain_turn record and any of that token's OR-merged artifact_glob rows (recursive **) matching an ordinary file with mtime at or after the trigger timestamp or state/.lock mtime. Same-turn Stop is clean. Blocking, not advisory. Default node rows are a header constant; FM_OWNER_INVOKE_NODES_REGISTRY overrides for tests only.
instances: Captain invoked wayfinder then sent another message with no map.md written since the invoke.
Captain invoked vision then sent another message with no VISION.md written since the invoke.

fixture_source.derivation: reconstruct the wait as a command-name node plus a later captain turn and no artifact, not as a same-turn Stop

ci_gate: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs bin/fm-test-run.sh --check-coverage and all portable lanes; the test inventory includes tests/fm-owner-invoke-wait-check.test.sh and tests/fm-turnend-guard.test.sh
limits: Only harness command-name user records arm a node, not slash text and not Skill tool loads.
Non-Claude primaries emit no command-name record.
Without a trigger timestamp or session lock mtime, leftover files do not clear the node.
A glob that matches any this-trigger-or-later file can clear the node, including an unrelated decisions file for grill-with-docs.
Split transcripts can hide the trigger or the later captain turn.
skipped: Adversarial rounds because size is light: one fresh reader via the test suite is enough.
